title: Hello, World!
explanation: Every Java program starts somewhere. That somewhere is a method called main -- the JVM looks for exactly this signature and runs it first: public static void main(String[] args).
Inside main, System.out.println(...) prints a line of text to the console below. Try changing the message and hit Run.
Notice the console pane updates live as your program runs -- that's the workflow you'll use for every lesson from here on.
